correctness.rationale: The source mean-field equations yield F1=1/2[(1+h1-2h1 x)((1-g1)x+g1 y)-(1-h1)x] and analogous F2 with h2<0. At any interior stationary point x>y: if x<=y, F1=h1 x(1-x)+A1(Q1-x)/2>0. With J=[[a,b],[c,d]], the row sums are h1(1-x-Q1), h2(1-y-Q2); -J^{-1}F_{g_i} gives exact derivatives and signs. Stable hyperbolic branch requires trace(J)<0,det(J)>0. Rational witness x=9/10,y=3/4,g1=g2=1/4,h1=5/28,h2=-2/19 has F=0, J=[[-109/448,3/28],[5/38,-3/40]], determinant 1413/340480>0, trace -713/2240<0, dP/dg1=688/785>0 and dP/dg2=-1220/471<0. Independently recomputed with exact rational symbolic Jacobian and implicit derivatives. Local undirected-block realization by reducing p11 while preserving symmetric p12=p21 and p22. No global monotonicity implied.
